notes:
Summary:
- Mid-market SaaS (product: user-facing conversational assistants for support + in-app workflows). Evaluating Hosted API first (fast time-to-value) with plan to move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost once POC succeeds.

Key requirements / pain points:
- Workload: multi-step agentic flows (search -> decide -> action). Heavy use of function/tool calling to query search index, call internal APIs, and trigger actions.
- Latency SLOs: aiming for <300ms median for single-turn responses; streaming first-token <100ms in reality for UX. Concerned about end-to-end latency when tool-calls involved.
- Reliability: main blocker is tool-call reliability/timeouts — they see intermittent external API timeouts causing agent failures. Want clear retry/backoff semantics, idempotency helpers, and fast fallbacks.
- Observability: need token-level cost/latency breakdown; per-route dashboards; tracing across tool-calls to debug slow external services.
- Security & compliance: must support SSO/SAML, KMS for customer keys, audit logs, and data residency options for EU customers. SOC2 required for procurement.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; interested in batching/quantization recommendations to reduce unit cost.

Quotes from discovery:
- "We need the assistant to never block the user; if a tool times out, it should degrade gracefully and continue with best-effort." - Head of Product
- "Streaming responsiveness is critical to perceived performance. First-token latency must be fast." - Eng manager

POC plan / success criteria:
- 2-week hosted POC (prod-like traffic sample):
  - Implement a representative agent flow: search (internal ES) + function-call to their action service + reply streaming.
  - Measure: median RTT single-turn <300ms, 95th pct tail for end-to-end <1.2s, first token streaming <120ms, successful tool-call chaining 99% without user-visible failure.
  - Observe costs and token breakdown; report recommendations for batching/quantization.

Requested deliverables from Redwood:
- Hosted POC environment + quickstart template for agent flow (function-calls + streaming).
- Guidance on retry/backoff and recommended fallback policies for tool-call timeouts.
- Dedicated pricing sheet with baseline throughput (reqs: 400 concurrent chats, peak 1500 rps tokens) and SLO options.
- Security FAQ / SOC2 evidence + KMS integration notes.

Open questions / blockers:
- How function-calling timeouts are surfaced to the SDK and what automatic retries Redwood performs (if any).
- Behavior and cost when using streaming + tool-calls for long multi-step flows (KV cache behavior, batching impact).
- Timeline for Dedicated onboarding (lead time, migration playbook).

Low-level notes from SE call (Diego):
- Will test intermittent external API failure scenarios; needs idempotency keys and per-call timeout tunables.
- Wants per-route tracing that includes tool-call durations and service identifiers.
- Will provide sample traffic trace and replay script for POC.

Next steps (short):
- Send Hosted POC access + sample agent quickstart (action-calls + streaming).
- Send Dedicated pricing and proposed SLA options.
- Kick off security review with Redwood Security pack (Diego + Laura to coordinate).
